authority.scope: Develop spatially braced CFRP tripod/quadpod alternatives and retain larger-section unbraced comparisons. No component, dimension, spine count, landing-gear arrangement, procurement or review baseline is selected.

scope: Eight exploratory native tube-component candidates. Actual solids measured; fittings, load paths and equipment incomplete. No automatic down-selection.
